CanonicalCorrectionResult.description:
``session.steer`` / ``session.redirect``: the correction verdict, or ``{voice_stopped: true}``
when the busy-time text was a bare stop phrase that ended the LOCAL voice chat.
CanonicalCorrectionResult.title: CanonicalCorrectionResult

CanonicalVoiceStopped.description:
A bare stop phrase typed while the session's voice chat is on: the chat ended, nothing was
admitted (TUI-26).
CanonicalVoiceStopped.title: CanonicalVoiceStopped

CatalogApproved.description:
The non-secret Advanced choices the user approved on a catalog row; a Try again after the
operation settled repeats them.
CatalogApproved.title: CatalogApproved

CatalogAppState.description: The desktop app a catalog plugin drives, from its ``hermes_platform`` declaration.
CatalogAppState.title: CatalogAppState

CatalogScan.description: The catalog's security scan of the pinned commit; read-only on the card.
CatalogScan.title: CatalogScan

CatalogServerError.description: An MCP server an installed plugin brought that did not connect, with the raw reason.
CatalogServerError.title: CatalogServerError

ConnectionDisplay.description: ``manage_connections`` action ``display``: the directory card, with these slugs pinned as Suggested.
ConnectionDisplay.title: ConnectionDisplay

ConnectionOperationTarget.description:
``Target.snapshot``: the link minted up front rides here, never in the model result. ``extra``
keys a leg records (``tools``, ``hint``) are typed here as they appear.
ConnectionOperationTarget.title: ConnectionOperationTarget

ConnectionRequestPayload.description:
``ConnectionOperation.request_payload``: opens the card; also the ``pending_connection`` resume
snapshot so a client that missed the event restores the card with the server's deadline.
ConnectionRequestPayload.title: ConnectionRequestPayload

ConnectionTargetEnvField.description:
One credential an MCP install still needs; the card renders a field per entry and sends the
values back with the approval.
ConnectionTargetEnvField.title: ConnectionTargetEnvField

InstallPhase.description: The slow steps of an install, as ids; the desktop catalog card words them in its own language.
InstallPhase.title: InstallPhase

ModelOptionProvider.description:
One ``hermes_cli/inventory.py::build_models_payload`` provider row (the union of every field
the builder sets; ``pricing_pending`` / ``free_tier_pending`` mark the cached-only path).
ModelOptionProvider.title: ModelOptionProvider

ModelPricing.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_pricing`` — formatted $/Mtok strings (``""`` unknown,
``"free"``); the sale fields are Nous Portal-only.
ModelPricing.title: ModelPricing

OpenRequestEntry.description:
One unanswered server→client request (``server_requests.Request.snapshot``); the reconnecting
client re-delivers it to its request handlers.
OpenRequestEntry.title: OpenRequestEntry

PlanGauge.description: ``gateway/session_usage.py::plan_gauge``: a window plan's allowance for the status bar.
PlanGauge.title: PlanGauge

PlanUsageGauge.description:
One server allowance on ``ModelOptionProvider.plan_usage``, in the server's order. ``label`` is the
server's id (``day`` / ``week`` / ``month`` / ``top_tier`` have client words; any other id shows
``title``). ``scope``: which models a full one stops (``all`` / ``top_tier``).
PlanUsageGauge.title: PlanUsageGauge

ProfileCanonicalSession.description: The profile's "Bot Chat" registry row; ``resolved_id`` is the live compression tip.
ProfileCanonicalSession.title: ProfileCanonicalSession

ProfileWorkerSession.description: Newest kanban/tool worker row, so rosters can show a profile as working.
ProfileWorkerSession.title: ProfileWorkerSession

ProviderLimit.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_limits`` — ``account``: the whole login is rate-limited until
``resets_at`` (ISO, absent when unknown); ``models``: only these models are, each until its time.
ProviderLimit.title: ProviderLimit

ProviderUsage.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_usage`` — the provider's subscription usage, from cache.

Multi-entry credential pools carry ``accounts`` (one row per account; the legacy ``windows``
stays EMPTY there — a provider-wide percentage across different logins would be fabricated).
Single-account providers keep the legacy ``windows`` gauge.
ProviderUsage.title: ProviderUsage

ProviderUsageAccount.description:
One account of a provider's credential pool (``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_pool_usage_accounts``).
``id`` is a stable non-secret account identity (never a key or URL); ``label`` may be empty (UI
falls back to a localized "Account N"). ``windows`` is empty while the account's usage is not
yet known — state carries the meaning, never a fabricated gauge.

``state``: ``ready`` — live quota below the cap (numeric windows present); ``limited`` — a live
credential-wide cooldown or exhausted account-scoped quota windows; ``unknown`` — no live
numeric windows (failed/empty fetch, stale snapshot, provider without a usage API);
``unavailable`` — DEAD auth row (kept visible, never a quota row).

``resets_at``: for a limited account, the LATEST of its exhausted account-scoped windows (or a
live cooldown when later); ``None`` when unknown (the frontend renders its own advisory, e.g.
the earliest limited sibling).
ProviderUsageAccount.title: ProviderUsageAccount

ProviderUsageWindow.description:
One subscription usage window (``agent/account_usage.py::AccountUsageWindow``): e.g. the 5-hour
session or the weekly cap, with how much of it is spent and when it rolls over (ISO).

``scope``: ``account`` — exhausting the window exhausts the whole login (Codex session/weekly,
so a limited account's resets_at must wait for it); ``model`` — the window caps only one model
family (Anthropic Opus/Sonnet weekly) and can never imply the account itself is out of quota.
ProviderUsageWindow.title: ProviderUsageWindow

SessionMutateParams.description:
``operation`` + ``payload`` are validated by ``hermes_state_mutations.validate_action``;
``expected_generation`` is required for delete/rewind/reset/branch/model/compress/reasoning/workspace.
``reasoning`` (``{effort}``) and ``workspace`` (``{cwd}``, refused ``session_busy`` mid-turn) rewrite
the session's frozen policy: session-scope ``/reasoning`` and Desktop's Move to project. ``edit_policy``
(``{policy}``: ask / workspace_session / session) is an ACP session's edit approval (main's ACP modes).
SessionMutateParams.title: SessionMutateParams

SessionMutateResult.description:
The committed mutation receipt plus the operation's projection (``title``, ``archived``,
``branched_session_id``, compress ``status``/``lines``, …). ``revision`` is absent only on a
read-only compress preview.
SessionMutateResult.title: SessionMutateResult

SkinPayload.description:
``tui_gateway/change_watcher.py::resolve_skin`` — the resolved active skin (``HermesSkin``).
``{}`` when the skin engine failed to load. Colour maps are token → colour string.
SkinPayload.title: SkinPayload

ToolLabel.description:
``tools.tool_labels.ToolLabel`` — what one call executed through the tool_search bridge is,
in words. Clients render ``text`` (or ``app``/``action`` in their own columns) and never parse
the tool name themselves.
ToolLabel.title: ToolLabel

ToolLabelKind.description: Which surface one inner call of a bridged ``tool_call`` runs on.
ToolLabelKind.title: ToolLabelKind

TranscriptMessage.description:
One transcript row as the gateway PROJECTS it for renderers (``session_history._project_history``):
``text``, display-only ``timestamp`` / ``display_kind`` / ``display_metadata``, the durable ``row_id``
rewind targets, and for tool rows raw ``content``, ``tool_call_id``, ``name``, ``context`` and ``args``.
Assistant detail sidecars (``reasoning``, …) ride as extra keys.
TranscriptMessage.title: TranscriptMessage
